name: Austria
dossier:
The Austria national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Das Nationalteam, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 24 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from UEFA to this expanded 48-team tournament.

Das Nationalteam travels with cohesion, fire, and a modern press to shake up Group J.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Austria will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group J and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group J. The connection between Marcel Sabitzer and Konrad Laimer is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Marcel Sabitzer - the clinical midfield who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Austria are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Austria's high-pressing system has made them one of Europe's most feared tactical sides.
Austria boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being Third place (1954).
